label: MaskBearer
description: The fighter who chooses a mask at runtime and delegates combat to it.
imageAlt: A warrior wearing a bear mask and carrying other masks at his belt.

fields.label: strategy: CombatStrategy
fields.description: Hold the equipped mask through the common CombatStrategy interface.

methods.label: equip(strategy: CombatStrategy)
methods.description: Replace the equipped strategy with the chosen mask.

methods.label: fight() · delegate
methods.description: Call fight() on the equipped strategy.

label: CombatStrategy
description: Defines the combat operation that every mask provides.

methods.label: fight() · contract
methods.description: Give every mask the same combat operation.

label: BearMask
description: Meets a troll’s charge with brute strength.
imageAlt: A carved bear mask with round ears and a broad muzzle.

methods.label: fight() · overpower
methods.description: Hold ground against the charge and drive the troll back.

label: SerpentMask
description: Summons a serpent-shaped shadow to bind the troll.
imageAlt: A green serpent mask with scales and an open mouth.

methods.label: fight() · bind
methods.description: Summon a shadow that coils around the troll and holds it fast.

label: OwlMask
description: Watches for an opening, even in the dark.
imageAlt: A carved owl mask with a long beak and wide eyeholes.

methods.label: fight() · watch and strike
methods.description: Track the troll’s movements and strike when its guard drops.
